cues.text: Frame 0, close: the roofer left, the client right, palms up, the house behind. Up top, big: $8,000 JOB. At 0.8 s the plate lands again with a second row in red: HE SAID NO. On "eight" a plain cut to the roofer alone, close, the same plate; he shrugs, then waves it off.
A plain cut to the client, close, palms up, smug. The plate: CLIENT WANTED over a big red $200 OFF.
A plain cut to the roofer, close, talking: HIS ACCOUNT, / VIA THE DAILY DOT, up until "two".
A plain cut to the client, close, right of frame; left, a plate: THE CLIENT: / A FLIPPER; under it a second plate: LOWER BIDS: / $7,500, then $7,800 half a second later.
Both plates give way to one cream card: CLIENT: / DROP / $200?
A plain cut to the roofer, close. One red stamp on the right: NO.
A plain cut to the two of them, close, the client's arms folded. Up top: HE SAYS IT WAS / NOT ABOUT / THE $200, the last row struck through in red.
A plain cut to the client, close and centered. The plate: CLIENT CARED / ABOUT PRICE; on "not" it lands again with a third row in red: NOT QUALITY.
A plain cut to the roofer, close, talking. A plate on the right: TO HIM:
He points; a red flag lands and the plate lands again with two more rows: TO HIM: / PROBLEM / JOB.
A plain cut: the yard bright again, the roofer waves; a cream plate: HE FELT / RELIEF.

The frame splits into two verdicts on the same man, the roofer on both sides: slate left, wine right. Left plate: SMART / CALL: then PROBLEM / JOB under it. The right plate starts with its first row: OR.
Right plate: OR / PRIDE: then on "cost" LOST / THE JOB under it. The roofer on the right shrugs.
The roofer on the left points down at the viewer. The caption says "You decide." Holds 1 s to the end.
